def rotateRight (l : List Int) (n : Nat) (h_precond : rotateRight_precond (l) (n)) : List Int :=
  let len := l.length
  let k := n % len
  if len = 0 then l
  else
    let rotated := l.drop k ++ l.take k
    rotated
